### Make Restitution - Truth For Life - August 24
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-24-2022.html
Passage: Exodus 22:6
Points:
- Careless actions and sinful influences can spread like wildfire, causing damage that cannot easily be repaired.
- While material damage under Mosaic law demanded restitution, spiritual harm to others often carries irreversible consequences.
- Conflict and jealousy within a church community can rapidly burn through spiritual blessings and harvest.
- The person who originally kindles discord bears the greatest moral culpability.
- Christians must examine their conduct and actively pray to be peacemakers who prevent division.

### Read the Bible: Exodus 22, John 1, Job 40, 2 Corinthians 10
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/exodus-22-john-1-job-40-2-corinthians-10/
Passage: Exodus 22:1-15
Points:
- Biblical restitution required thieves to return what was taken plus an extra penalty to compensate the victim's loss and violation.
- Thieves who lacked financial means to pay restitution were placed in temporary indentured servitude to work off their debt.
- Judges were tasked with discerning contested property claims, requiring proven liars to pay double to their neighbors.
- Restitution directly preserves the core biblical principle of retributive justice rather than vague therapeutic penalties.
- The legal requirement that justice must be fully satisfied foreshadows the cross of Christ satisfying God's justice for sin.
